query: CREATE TABLE oauth_login(login_id UUID NOT NULL, user_id UUID NOT NULL, client_id TEXT NOT NULL, scope TEXT NOT NULL, created TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL, last_used TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL, revoked TIMESTAMPTZ, created_ip INET NOT NULL, created_user_agent TEXT NOT NULL, login_type USER_LOGIN_TYPE NOT NULL GENERATED ALWAYS AS ('oauth_login') STORED);
